About Millennium




We are fundamental technologists with an optimistic future world view.

Our roots trace back to Millennium Technology Value Partners founded over two decades ago, using a research oriented approach to de-risk venture investing. We have backed internet giants like Meta, X, Alibaba, Spotify and Pinterest in the past and are now investing in deep tech trailblazers poised to redefine our future.
